\begin{example} \end{example}[CW structure on real projective space $\RP ^n$] ↗ def:cell-complex ↗ ex:sphere-two-cells 1. ch0:0.4\group CW Complexes

$\RP ^n$ is the quotient of $S^n$ by $v\sim -v$, equivalently a hemisphere $D^n$ with antipodal points of its boundary identified. Thus $\RP ^n$ is obtained from $\RP ^{n-1}$ by attaching an $n$-cell via $S^{n-1}\to \RP ^{n-1}$, and has one cell $e^i$ in each dimension $0\le i\le n$. \end{example}
